case_name: Mrutunjaya Swain & Others vs State Of Odisha & Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Odisha & another (wife, opposite party No.2)

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife reported at Mancheswar P.S. alleging dowry demand and torture; F.I.R. registered; charge sheet filed; trial court took cognizance; parties settled dispute; petitioners seek quashing of criminal prosecution.

legal_principles.principle: A decree of divorce by mutual consent dissolves the marriage.
legal_principles.held: it is humbly submitted that the marriage between the Petitioner no.1 and Opp. Party no.2 has been dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent of learned Judge, Family Court, Bhubaneswar in Civil Proceeding No.692 of 2021.

legal_principles.principle: A criminal proceeding pending against a person cannot be quashed without considering the merits of the case.
legal_principles.held: Opp. Party no.2 humbly submits that she has no objections to the prayer of the petitioners in this present case for a direction of this Hon'ble Court for quashing of the order of cognizance and the criminal proceeding pending against the petitioners...
cited_cases: Mrutunjaya Swain & Others vs State Of Odisha & Another, (2025)

outcome.final_order: The marriage between the petitioner No.1 and the opposite party No.2 was dissolved by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
use_for_drafting: responding to a domestic violence charge
